title: Week 52: Year-End Review and Next Steps
instructions: 这是为B2–C1学习者设计的原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。请先听/读transcript，完成10道听力题；然后学习语法规则并完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目答案必须来自原文，注意NOT GIVEN的缺失证据。
transcript:
Maya: Hi, Leo. You look tired. Are you still working on your year-end review?
Leo: Yes, I am. I have to present my learning strategy for the year. I’ve been studying English for twelve months now, and I want to show what worked and what didn’t.
Maya: That sounds useful. What’s your main finding?
Leo: Well, I started with a very ambitious plan: two hours of study every day. But by March, I was already behind. I realized that consistency matters more than intensity. So I changed to thirty minutes every morning, and that worked much better. It was easier to stick to, and I felt less stressed. The shorter routine also made it easier to fit study into a busy day, so I missed fewer sessions.
Maya: So you dropped the long sessions?
Leo: Not exactly. I kept one long session on Sundays for writing practice, but the daily short sessions became my core routine. That combination gave me both regular practice and time for deeper work. The Sunday session let me focus on longer texts and review my writing more carefully.
Maya: Good. What about grammar? You used to make the same mistakes again and again.
Leo: Right. I still do sometimes. For example, I often forget the third-person -s in fast speech. And I sometimes use the present perfect when the past simple is better. But I’ve made a checklist for my exam preparation.
Maya: A checklist? Tell me more.
Leo: It’s short—only five points. First, check subject-verb agreement in every sentence. Second, ask: is the time clear? If yes, use past simple. Third, for listening, predict the answer type before you hear it. Fourth, for reading, underline the exact words that match the question. Fifth, leave two minutes to transfer answers. These steps help me avoid careless mistakes. The checklist is quick to use, so I can apply it during practice tests without losing time.
Maya: That’s practical. Did you find any resources especially helpful?
Leo: Yes. I listened to short podcasts every day. They improved my listening and gave me new vocabulary. I also kept a vocabulary notebook, but I only reviewed it once a week. That wasn’t enough. Next year, I’ll review it every other day. Reviewing more often should help me remember new words and use them more actively.
Maya: What about speaking?
Leo: I joined a weekly conversation group. At first, I was nervous, but now I feel more confident. I still make mistakes, but I can keep the conversation going. The group is supportive, and we practice real-life situations. That regular speaking practice has made a big difference in my fluency.
Maya: So what’s your plan for next year?
Leo: I want to focus on two things: speaking fluency and reading speed. I’ll continue the daily thirty-minute sessions, but I’ll add a ten-minute review of my mistakes every Friday. And I’ll take a mock test once a month to track my progress. The monthly test will show me whether my reading speed is improving and where I still need work.
Maya: That sounds balanced. Will you change your checklist?
Leo: Yes, I’ll update it every month. The checklist should reflect my current errors, not old ones. That way it stays useful. If I notice a new mistake pattern, I can add it and remove points I no longer need.
Maya: One last question: what advice would you give to someone starting now?
Leo: Start small. Don’t plan two hours a day if you can’t keep it. And review your mistakes regularly—that’s where the real progress is. Also, be patient with yourself; learning a language takes time.

grammar.title: 整理仍会复现的错误，形成简短、可执行的考前检查单
grammar.explanation: 在英语学习中，有些错误会反复出现，比如第三人称单数漏加 -s、时态混用等。要解决这些问题，可以制作一个简短的检查单。检查单应该用祈使句或 should 来表达建议，例如 'Check subject-verb agreement.' 或 'You should check subject-verb agreement.'。检查单要具体、可操作，并且定期更新，只包含当前常犯的错误。
grammar.example: First, check subject-verb agreement in every sentence. Second, ask: is the time clear? If yes, use past simple.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a checklist.
questions.explanation: 检查单常用祈使句，动词原形开头。
questions.evidence: First, check subject-verb agreement in every sentence.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses 'should' for advice?
options: You should review your mistakes regularly.
You should to review your mistakes regularly.
You should reviewing your mistakes regularly.
You should reviewed your mistakes regularly.
answers: You should review your mistakes regularly.
questions.evidence: And review your mistakes regularly—that’s where the real progress is.

questions.prompt: Find the sentence with correct third-person singular agreement.
options: She check her answers every time.
She checks her answers every time.
She checking her answers every time.
She checked her answers every time.
answers: She checks her answers every time.
questions.explanation: 第三人称单数一般现在时动词加 -s。
questions.evidence: First, check subject-verb agreement in every sentence.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses the past simple correctly?
options: Yesterday I go to the library.
Yesterday I went to the library.
Yesterday I have gone to the library.
Yesterday I am going to the library.
answers: Yesterday I went to the library.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去时间，用过去式 went。
be动词提前构成一般疑问句。
questions.evidence: Second, ask: is the time clear?

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a correct imperative for a checklist?
options: Leave two minutes to transfer answers.
Leaving two minutes to transfer answers.
You leaving two minutes to transfer answers.
To leave two minutes to transfer answers.
answers: Leave two minutes to transfer answers.
questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头。
questions.evidence: Fifth, leave two minutes to transfer answers.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement.
options: The checklist reflect my current errors.
The checklist reflects my current errors.
The checklist reflecting my current errors.
The checklist to reflect my current errors.
answers: The checklist reflects my current errors.
questions.explanation: 主语 The checklist 是单数，动词加 -s。
questions.evidence: The checklist should reflect my current errors, not old ones.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses 'every other day'?
options: I review it every other day.
I review it every other days.
I review it every another day.
I review it every others day.
answers: I review it every other day.
questions.explanation: every other day 是固定搭配，表示每隔一天。
questions.evidence: Next year, I’ll review it every other day.
